payload.name: Extract Routine Frequency Statements
payload.description: During construction extraction, when a user states how often they perform a recurring activity (e.g., multiple times a day, weekly, rarely), create a candidate memory capturing the activity and its frequency.
content: During extraction, if a message contains an explicit frequency or schedule for a recurring activity the user performs (e.g., 'very often', 'multiple times a day', 'every weekend'), create a candidate memory of type 'state' or 'event' that records the activity and its frequency, linked to the source message.
Do not extract when the frequency is about a one-time event, a hypothetical scenario, or someone other than the user.

solves: Construction failures occur when a clear statement of how often a user does a recurring activity is omitted during extraction, so the fact is never stored. This skill applies when a future session contains an explicit frequency description of a user's regular routine (e.g., 'I walk my dog twice a day', 'very often, multiple times a day'). It must not apply to one-time events, hypothetical statements, or frequencies about other people.
